RESEARCH REFERENCE / 04

First Value Engine: research, not product UI.

A proposed GTM experiment workbench for acquisition, activation, onboarding/billing and growth experiments. All scope and milestone definitions remain provisional.

PROPOSED SCOPE

Make the next experiment defensible.

  • Validate synthetic signup/event CSVs, with explicit row-level issues.
  • Declare first-value milestones, windows and cohort eligibility.
  • Preserve unknown segments and incomplete outcomes.
  • Show rationale behind experiment ranking.
  • Construct UTM strings and export an activation plan.

No real aircraft work, payments, integrations, private data, campaign launches or unsupported claims about missing Rebolt features.

PROPOSED METRIC SAFEGUARD

Unknown outcomes are not failures.

N / D / U

N = confirmed value. D = eligible mature units.
U = outcomes unknown due to incomplete evidence.

Bounds: N/D → (N+U)/D
Coverage: (D−U)/D

Synthetic arithmetic illustration:
4 confirmed / 10 eligible / 2 unknown → 40–60% bounds; 80% coverage.

Not a Rebolt benchmark, real cohort, application result or tested uplift.

Stop at the research gate.

Commit brand evidence and the brief. Await scoped product-use notes before UI implementation. Later delivery may include PM docs, tests with actual results, free Cloudflare deployment and a voiced live-browser demonstration. None is delivered at this stage.
